readings: Include tracks with non-null `Track.Bytes` strictly greater than 10,323,804. For each media type with at least one included track, calculate the average of its tracks’ individual `Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds` values. Which media types have an average strictly greater than the unweighted average of those per-media-type averages? Show each qualifying media type’s name, its average, and its average minus the unweighted average. Do not round any value.

Include tracks with non-null `Track.Bytes` greater than or equal to 10,323,804. For each media type with at least one included track, calculate the average of its tracks’ individual `Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds` values. Which media types have an average strictly greater than the unweighted average of those per-media-type averages? Show each qualifying media type’s name, its average, and its average minus the unweighted average. Do not round any value.

Include tracks with non-null `Track.Bytes` strictly less than 10,323,804. For each media type with at least one included track, calculate the average of its tracks’ individual `Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds` values. Which media types have an average strictly greater than the unweighted average of those per-media-type averages? Show each qualifying media type’s name, its average, and its average minus the unweighted average. Do not round any value.

Include tracks with non-null `Track.Bytes` less than or equal to 10,323,804. For each media type with at least one included track, calculate the average of its tracks’ individual `Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds` values. Which media types have an average strictly greater than the unweighted average of those per-media-type averages? Show each qualifying media type’s name, its average, and its average minus the unweighted average. Do not round any value.
queries:
WITH media_averages AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
      AND t.Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
    Name,
    average_bytes_per_millisecond,
    average_bytes_per_millisecond - (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) FROM media_averages) AS difference
FROM media_averages
WHERE average_bytes_per_millisecond > (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) FROM media_averages)

WITH media_averages AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name,
        AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
      AND t.Bytes >= 10323804
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
    Name,
    average_bytes_per_millisecond,
    average_bytes_per_millisecond - (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) FROM media_averages) AS difference
FROM media_averages
WHERE average_bytes_per_millisecond > (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) FROM media_averages);

WITH media_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.MediaTypeId,
        AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
      AND t.Bytes < 10323804
    GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_of_media_averages
    FROM media_averages
)
SELECT
    m.Name,
    a.average_bytes_per_millisecond,
    a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_of_media_averages AS difference
FROM media_averages AS a
JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = a.MediaTypeId
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.average_of_media_averages

WITH media_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.MediaTypeId,
        AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
      AND t.Bytes <= 10323804
    GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS value
    FROM media_averages
)
SELECT
    m.Name,
    a.average_bytes_per_millisecond,
    a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.value AS difference
FROM media_averages AS a
JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = a.MediaTypeId
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.value
